header.numbers_note: counts are rounded to 2 significant figures, so parts may not add up exactly to totals; every check and estimate was worked out on the unrounded data

scorecard.why: robots.txt allows all crawlers and names the sitemap; http:// 301s to https:// in 1 hop; the certificate is valid for over 30 more days and HSTS is on. https://www. answers 200 instead of redirecting, and http://www. 301s to it (https://www.example.com/) in 1 hop. The www home page declares a canonical to https://example.com/ (onpage_instant_pages), so it is a warn, not a fail.

20 of 20 top pages are indexed and 19 declare a canonical that matches Google's choice; / has no user-declared canonical in the inspection (Google chose /); its live HTML declares a self-referencing canonical (onpage_instant_pages), so Google picked the same page. Of 480 sitemap URLs, 190 had no impressions; 20 of 30 sampled were not indexed (14 crawled not indexed, 3 unknown to Google, 2 redirect errors, 1 discovered not crawled).

All 19 GA4 landing pages checked (the top 15 by sessions, with ties) return 404. /integrations/page-1 also has 250 Search Console impressions. /integrations/page-2 also has 17 Search Console impressions. GA4 recorded 49 sessions on them, which shows people reach them; GA4 is not measuring search traffic on this site (see Search performance), so that count is a floor, not a share of the site's traffic. All 8 audit-set pages end in a 200 (/blog/post-2 through a redirect). Of the 10 Search Console URLs not in the sitemap with the most impressions, 9 redirect in a single 308 hop and 1 returns 404 (/integrations/page-1). No chains or loops.

scorecard.key_number: 4 of 8 pages have titles over 60 characters
scorecard.why: Every page has one H1 and a self-referencing canonical, and no titles repeat. The /about title is 27 characters (under 30); 2 descriptions run over 160 characters; / and /integrations/page-3 have images without alt text; the home page skips heading levels.

scorecard.key_number: 47% of the sample crawled but not indexed
scorecard.why: 3 audit-set pages have under 300 words (the library hub has 92 words after JavaScript runs). Crawled-not-indexed pages cluster in library (6), docs (4), templates (3).

Home LCP 8.4 s and blog post LCP 13.0 s are past 4 s; pricing 3.2 s and the library hub 3.0 s are in the warn band. CLS is fine everywhere. The slowest template is the blog post (/blog/post-1, 2200 impressions); its top resource-optimizations saving: Reduce unused JavaScript (Est savings of 1,300 KiB).

scorecard.key_number: ~48 clicks at stake from 4 snippet gaps
scorecard.why: 4 live pages rank in the top 10 with a CTR under half the site median for their position. GA4 recorded 1 Organic Search session against 1800 Search Console clicks, so GA4 is not measuring search traffic.

3 backlinks point at broken pages. One country-code TLD outside the site's market carries over a third of the links (about 40%) in the TLD breakdown. The About page has 170 words and a 27-character title. Rich results found: Breadcrumbs on about 15 of the top 20 pages.

page_table_note: word_count is the HTML text without JavaScript, except the library hub (/library), which builds its cards in JavaScript and was re-run with JavaScript, so its count is after rendering. description_length is rounded to 2 significant figures; the over-160 check used the exact lengths. title_length and word_count are shifted a few units, each inside its band (under 30 / 30-60 / over 60 characters; under or over 300 words), so the checks are unchanged.
